name: @veda-hq/agnipariksha
description: Mutation gate over stock StrykerJS: mutates the files a push changed, lane by lane, and blocks on a surviving mutant. Lanes come from agnipariksha.json. Also an arid-node ignorer plugin: @veda-hq/agnipariksha/arid-nodes.

scripts.smoke: out=$(node dist/cli.js --lane smoke-no-such-lane); code=$?; echo "$out"; case "$out" in *'REFUSED: --lane names no lane in agnipariksha.json: "smoke-no-such-lane" (its lanes: "agnipariksha"'*) [ $code = 2 ] ;; *) false ;; esac && node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('@veda-hq/agnipariksha/arid-nodes'); const [p] = m.strykerPlugins; if (m.strykerPlugins.length !== 1 || p.kind !== 'Ignore' || p.name !== 'agnipariksha-arid-nodes' || typeof new p.injectableClass().shouldIgnore !== 'function') throw new Error('arid-nodes is not a Stryker Ignore plugin');"
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm smoke
